name: image-gen
description: Image generation through a configured API-key provider or the connected ChatGPT account. Generated images show directly in the chat.

configSchema.label: Provider
configSchema.hint: Which configured provider renders the images: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (its key and base URL are reused) or the connected ChatGPT account. Add providers in Settings → Brain.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.hint: Image model id. ChatGPT account: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2 or gpt-image-1.5. API-key provider: whichever model its Images API serves, e.g. gpt-image-1. Empty uses the default for the chosen provider.
